mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4.0% and PAYEMS increases by > 200,000 in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when the labor market trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and future earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and SPX 20-day returns is < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling increased housing demand, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 60 trading days due to the housing market's multiplier effect on the broader economy.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 55% of instances when the HOUST trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: The spread between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (inflation-adjusted) being in the lower 25th percentile of its historical range indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL in lower 25th percentile of historical range
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.10) in periods with the described spread condition.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the level of UNRATE, as a standalone indicator of labor market health, inversely correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with lower UNRATE values indicating stronger returns.
failure_condition: The correlation coefficient between UNRATE and SPX 5-day returns is > -0.10 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS increasing by more than 5% month-over-month, indicating a surge in retail sales, forecasts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the boost in consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of instances when the RSAFS trigger is met.
